translations.web: Now because we eat the salt of the palace, and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,
translations.bsb: Now because we are in the service of the palace and it is not fitting for us to allow the king to be dishonored, we have sent to inform the king
translations.kjv: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
translations.asv: Now because we eat the salt of the palace, and it is not meet for us to see the king's dishonor, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
